name: Sequenced Assembly
description: A recipe made by looping one item through machine steps.

pages.title: Sequenced Assembly
pages.text:
**Sequenced assembly** makes an item by sending it along a belt through a chain of steps, such as deployers and a press, repeated several times. In between it is an **incomplete** item.\
\
The Precision Mechanism is the first one. JEI shows each loop.
